messages.content: You are a senior code auditor. Review ONLY the code given. Report real defects, not style. Reply with JSON only: {"verdict":"PASS|FAIL","findings":[{"id":"F1","severity":"critical|high|medium|low","file":"...","line":0,"issue":"...","evidence":"quote the exact code","fix":"..."}],"confidence":0.0}. AUDIT QUESTION: Batch 41 cycle 4 (verification) = PROTECTED REFERENCE regression step 7 (pipeline/regression.sh, set -euo pipefail). The reference's small files incl. SHA256SUMS are git-tracked and pinned by tag ref-pulse-moments-2026-11-12; large files untracked, listed in SHA256SUMS. This diff implements cycle 3: SKIP iff `git ls-files --error-unmatch references/pulse_moments_2026-11-12/SHA256SUMS` fails (this checkout does not track the reference; the index still lists a tracked file whose working copy was deleted); when tracked: the manifest checker must exit 0, the tag must exist (explicit FAIL otherwise), and `git diff --quiet <tag> -- <reference dir>` must hold. Proven on a throwaway repo: intact 0; tag missing 1; tag restored 0; directory deleted 1; directory back 0; a file changed with SHA256SUMS re-made to match 1; an untracked directory SKIP.
FIND: whether the fix is correct and complete; any way an intact reference fails or a changed / deleted / replaced one passes. Reply with the JSON verdict; keep the reasoning short; at most 3 findings.

diff --git a/pipeline/regression.sh b/pipeline/regression.sh
index bdcb18a9..017e7072 100755
--- a/pipeline/regression.sh
+++ b/pipeline/regression.sh
@@ -99,13 +99,17 @@ echo ""
 # ── Step 7: third protected reference (orchestrator order 2026-11-12 '20:30' (c)) ──

 REF_M=references/pulse_moments_2026-11-12
-if git ls-files --error-unmatch "$REF_M/SHA256SUMS" >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ -e "$REF_M" ]; then
-    # tracked by this checkout (or present): it must be whole (audit batch 41: a deleted directory is a FAIL, never a

+if git ls-files --error-unmatch "$REF_M/SHA256SUMS" >/dev/null 2>&1; then   # the index lists it even when deleted

     if ! python3 pipeline/check_reference_manifest.py "$REF_M"; then
         echo "  FAIL: the protected moments reference changed (docs/references/REFERENCE_PULSE_MOMENTS_2026-11-12.md)"
         exit 1
     fi
+    if ! git rev-parse -q --verify refs/tags/ref-pulse-moments-2026-11-12 >/dev/null; then

+        exit 1
+    fi
     if ! git diff --quiet ref-pulse-moments-2026-11-12 -- "$REF_M"; then
